notes.title: Mojo 2 - I want you to help me
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33713086/bb7ef6319102091df3104ff28ce19bee40142497.png[/img]

Due to unknown reasons, Mojo 2 has an abnormally low number of reviews*. 
I initially intended to support Mojo 2 for as long as possible and to release a couple of free DLCs for the main game. 

The visibility of the game in Steam depends directly on the number of reviews, just like the users’ decision to buy the game. To our regret, the current situation with the reviews has a very negative impact on the game. The plans for the development of the game after the release in January are now open to question.

* [i]In the first month after the release Mojo 2 gained 6 times fewer reviews than XXZ:XXL despite the fact that over the stated period of time we have sold the same number of copies of both games.[/i]
